criteria.description: The resolving line (punch, hook anchor, or punctuating short line) lands on the 4th bar of the group, or the 4th position of the phrase.
Internal multi-rhyme chains within the bar, not just end-rhymes. Two or more rhyming words inside a single bar.
The punch or focal stress lands on bar 2 or 3 rather than the expected bar 1 or 4 — the listener's expectation is broken before the resolve.
The bar-shift + resolve pattern repeats across verses without exception — architecture, not accident.
signals: pattern present in verse 1 and verse 2

name: That Boy Hi Hat signature rubric

recursive_logic.rule: Any track scoring >= 70 carries the signature; any artist with 3+ tracks >= 70 is a signature artist. Re-run across the catalog as new tracks arrive.
steps: For each candidate track, score the 4 criteria from the transcript or audio.
If score >= 70, attach the signature node edge manifested_in.
If an artist accumulates 3+ tracks >= 70, attach owns_signature.
Feed results back into the graph; the graph feeds the next scoring pass.
